## Behaviour and scope

Describe the concrete change and the actual public entry points that exercise it.

## Evidence

Record exact source and environment identities, relevant commands and observed results. Include affected counterpart semantics, documentation and benchmarks where applicable. Explain unavailable references and remaining limitations.

## Compatibility and data

Describe compatibility, dependency and source-format effects. Confirm that fixtures and included assets have appropriate provenance and contain no private data.

## Reversion

State how to revert the change while preserving prior results and user data.
